svg.title: Session resolution
svg.desc: An inbound channel message derives a SessionKey from the DM or group scope, the owning agent and the thread, passes the thread-binding, pause and task-bridge checks, is queued, and reaches SessionService.getOrCreateByKey in dispatchChannelTurn. The main session, scheduled jobs, tasks and sessions_spawn build a key from an id; web chat creates an unkeyed user session. Sessions live under sessions/ in the data directory.

g.text: Hover a box for what it does; its connections light up. Click it to open its section.
A chip inside a box is an exit not drawn as an arrow. Inside a rendered document this image is static; click it to open the interactive SVG.

svg.text: Every caller ends at SessionService. Only channel messages derive their key; the other surfaces build theirs from an id.

g.class: e f-main f-cron f-task f-spawn f-web t-ss
g.text: getOrCreateByKey(key)
meta.json, key index, transcript
handleInboundMessage
ChannelManager: finds the channel that owns the sender
no owner: dropped
handleInboundMessage · channel_manager.dart looks up the channel that owns the sender
A message with no owning channel is dropped before any session is touched.
deriveSessionKey
scope from LiveScopeConfig, agent from the allowlist row
deriveSessionKey · ChannelManager.deriveSessionKey: DmScope or GroupScope pick the SessionKey factory
The allowlist row's agent becomes the agentId component; message.threadId appends :thread:<id>.
thread binding lookup
task thread: use the binding's sessionKey
bound: binding key
thread binding lookup · ChannelTaskBridge.lookupThreadBinding answers only for task bindings
A run binding never routes a message to a session.
pause check
reserved commands exempt
paused: queued
pause check · while paused, PauseController queues the message with its resolved route
Resume drains the queue per session key.
ChannelTaskBridge.tryHandle
reserved commands, rate limit, bound thread
handled: stops
ChannelTaskBridge.tryHandle · reserved commands, the per-sender rate limit and a bound thread are handled here
If the bridge handles the message, routing stops: no session turn is dispatched.
MessageQueue, dispatchChannelTurn
debounce; persists the user message
MessageQueue, dispatchChannelTurn · dispatchChannelTurn: getOrCreateByKey(type: channel), insert the user message, then admission
The message is persisted before admission, so a cap-deferred turn waits and retries inside dispatchChannelTurn.
Main session
getOrCreateMainSession(): key main
Main session · created once at storage wiring with the literal key main
Maintenance never touches it; the daily and idle reset archive it and create a fresh main session.
Scheduled job
SessionKey.cronSession(jobId)
Scheduled job · ScheduleService builds the key from the job id
A perFireSession job appends a timestamp to the jobId, so each fire is its own session.
Task
SessionKey.taskSession(taskId)
Task · TaskExecutor (task_executor_helpers.dart) builds the key from the task id
Task sessions are protected from maintenance, and the reset timers skip them.
sessions_spawn
SessionKey.logicalAgentSession(agentId, conversationId)
sessions_spawn · LogicalAgentSessionService dispatch
The key string is the handle sessions_send takes.
Web chat
user session, no key: createSession()
Web chat · POST /api/sessions creates a type user session with channelKey null
A temporary conversation is created the same way; neither is ever keyed.
SessionService
getOrCreateByKey (keyed) or createSession (web chat); dartclaw_core storage
RepoLock on .session_keys.json; drops a stale or archived mapping and creates a new session
SessionService · getOrCreateByKey is serialized by RepoLock on .session_keys.json
A live session is lazy-migrated (type, channelKey, provider, securityProfile, executionMode) and checked against its pinned AgentWorkspace.
sessions/
.session_keys.json maps key to UUID; <uuid>/meta.json holds the Session and conversationState; messages.ndjson is the transcript
sessions/ · the key index, one directory per session, and the append-only transcript
meta.json nests ConversationState; messages.ndjson is never truncated in normal operation.
